reproducibility_caveat: local_training() minibatch shuffle and the malicious-delta injection in run_standard_fl/run_fl_mlkem/run_fl_hybrid/both ablations draw from the unseeded global numpy RNG (np.random.default_rng() / np.random.normal), not a seed-derived generator. Only model init, data generation, and client partitioning are actually controlled by CONFIG['seed']=42. Re-running this script will NOT reproduce bit-identical numbers; only the qualitative pattern (standard/mlkem degrade under attack from round 4, hybrid detects and stays at 100% accuracy) is expected to replicate. See docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md Sec 3.9 and docs/UPSTREAM_SECURITY_FINDINGS.md Sec 5.7.
